constraints: CHECK (task_kind IS NULL OR task_kind IN ('reading', 'pyq', 'other'))
CHECK ((kind = 'topic' AND task_kind IS NULL AND base_minutes IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'topic' AND task_kind IS NOT NULL AND base_minutes BETWEEN 10 AND 50))

data.name: review_events
constraints: CHECK (grade IS NULL OR grade IN ('forgot', 'shaky', 'solid'))
CHECK (belt_before IS NULL OR belt_before IN ('unread', 'red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'light_green', 'green'))
CHECK (belt_after IS NULL OR belt_after IN ('unread', 'red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'light_green', 'green'))

CHECK ((event_type = 'first_study' AND grade IS NULL AND minutes IS NOT NULL AND belt_before = 'unread' AND belt_after = 'red' AND interval_days = 1 AND ladder_due_after IS NOT NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NULL AND batch_id IS NULL) OR (event_type = 'review' AND grade IS NOT NULL AND minutes IS NOT NULL AND belt_before IS NOT NULL AND belt_before <> 'unread' AND belt_after IS NOT NULL AND belt_after <> 'unread' AND interval_days IS NOT NULL AND ladder_due_after IS NOT NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NULL AND batch_id IS NULL) OR (event_type = 'reschedule' AND grade IS NULL AND minutes IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND belt_before IS NOT NULL AND belt_after = belt_before AND interval_days IS NULL AND ladder_due_after IS NOT NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NULL AND batch_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'undo' AND grade IS NULL AND minutes IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND belt_before IS NULL AND belt_after IS NULL AND interval_days IS NULL AND ladder_due_after IS NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NOT NULL AND batch_id IS NULL))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exams" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "exam_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_inbox" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_inbox" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_subjects" ("exam_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exams (id), "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id), PRIMARY KEY ("exam_id", "subject_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_nodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id), "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES study_nodes (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_kind" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_text" TEXT NULL, "base_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind IN ('topic', 'task', 'subtask')), CHECK (task_kind IS NULL OR task_kind IN ('reading', 'pyq', 'other')), CHECK ((kind = 'topic' AND task_kind IS NULL AND base_minutes IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'topic' AND task_kind IS NOT NULL AND base_minutes BETWEEN 10 AND 50)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tree_uri" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "granted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (purpose IN ('sources', 'backup')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "node_sources" ("node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES study_nodes (id), "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "folder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES source_folders (id), "relative_path" TEXT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NULL, "location_note" TEXT NULL, "excerpt" TEXT NULL, "link_status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("node_id"), CHECK (source_type IN ('pdf', 'book', 'web', 'ai_chat', 'video', 'notes', 'lecture', 'app', 'other_device')), CHECK (link_status IN ('ok', 'needs_relink', 'not_linked')), CHECK (excerpt IS NULL OR length(excerpt) <= 20000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES study_nodes (id), "started_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "confirmed_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited" IN (0, 1)), "discarded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("discarded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES study_nodes (id), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade" TEXT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES study_sessions (id), "belt_before" TEXT NULL, "belt_after" TEXT NULL, "interval_days" INTEGER NULL, "ladder_due_after" TEXT NULL, "explanation" TEXT NULL, "undoes_event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES review_events (id), "batch_id" TEXT NULL, "scheduler" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ladder', "scheduler_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (scheduler = 'ladder' AND scheduler_version = 1), CHECK (interval_days IS NULL OR interval_days >= 1), CHECK (minutes IS NULL OR minutes >= 0), CHECK (grade IS NULL OR grade IN ('forgot', 'shaky', 'solid')), CHECK (belt_before IS NULL OR belt_before IN ('unread', 'red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'light_green', 'green')), CHECK (belt_after IS NULL OR belt_after IN ('unread', 'red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'light_green', 'green')), CHECK ((event_type = 'first_study' AND grade IS NULL AND minutes IS NOT NULL AND belt_before = 'unread' AND belt_after = 'red' AND interval_days = 1 AND ladder_due_after IS NOT NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NULL AND batch_id IS NULL) OR (event_type = 'review' AND grade IS NOT NULL AND minutes IS NOT NULL AND belt_before IS NOT NULL AND belt_before <> 'unread' AND belt_after IS NOT NULL AND belt_after <> 'unread' AND interval_days IS NOT NULL AND ladder_due_after IS NOT NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NULL AND batch_id IS NULL) OR (event_type = 'reschedule' AND grade IS NULL AND minutes IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND belt_before IS NOT NULL AND belt_after = belt_before AND interval_days IS NULL AND ladder_due_after IS NOT NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NULL AND batch_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'undo' AND grade IS NULL AND minutes IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND belt_before IS NULL AND belt_after IS NULL AND interval_days IS NULL AND ladder_due_after IS NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NOT NULL AND batch_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_state" ("node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES study_nodes (id), "belt" TEXT NOT NULL, "ladder_due" TEXT NULL, "last_review_date" TEXT NULL, "review_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("node_id"), CHECK (belt IN ('unread', 'red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'light_green', 'green')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_plans" ("local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "review_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_read_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "waiting_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "waiting_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "catch_up_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "catch_up_batch_id" TEXT NULL, "built_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_date"), CHECK (catch_up_state IN ('none', 'offered', 'accepted', 'declined')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_plan_rows" ("local_date" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES day_plans (local_date) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES study_nodes (id), "row_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "done_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_date", "position"), CHECK (row_type IN ('review', 'first_read')), CHECK (reason IN ('due', 'overdue', 'deadline_risk', 'catch_up', 'first_read')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_meta" ("format_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subjects_one_inbox ON subjects (is_inbox) WHERE is_inbox = 1
CREATE INDEX study_nodes_parent_id ON study_nodes (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX study_nodes_subject_id ON study_nodes (subject_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_sessions_one_open ON study_sessions ((ended_at_utc IS NULL)) WHERE ended_at_utc IS NULL
CREATE INDEX review_events_node_at ON review_events (node_id, at_utc)
CREATE INDEX item_state_ladder_due ON item_state (ladder_due)
CREATE INDEX item_state_belt ON item_state (belt)
